entries.notes: All 11 pseudo-package and dynamic-import declarations are translated with real temporary entry files and node_modules package trees. Coverage requires the four Next marker packages to resolve to empty modules, preserves unrelated code, leaves a missing marker unresolved without the plugin, inlines ordinary and nested dynamic imports, and retains explicitly external dynamic imports. Final GREEN must use the real Rust bundle graph; pseudo-module replacement must be exact-name only so attacker-controlled lookalike specifiers cannot be erased, while workflow bundles must not leave runtime import() edges that the sandbox cannot execute.
